correctness.rationale: Direct independent Fourier-slice derivation yields C0(m)=sum_{j=0}^2|x_{m+j}|², C1(m)=x_{m+1}conj(x_m)+x_{m+2}conj(x_{m+1}), C2(m)=x_{m+2}conj(x_m). Their equality fixes individual moduli because the 3-cycle sum has trivial periodic kernel when gcd(N,3)=1; C2 fixes a two-periodic phase ratio; C1 then forces alternating adjacent products and a uniquely specified W. The y-construction recomputes all three lags, hence the complete N² spectrogram. Checked the explicit partner directly at N=8,10,14 against a separately implemented STFT; errors <2e-13. This is proof for all admissible N, not finite extrapolation. Full-support excludes zeros, and N=6 / 3|N are not claimed.
residual_risks: Finite numerical checks do not address zero signal coordinates, 3|N, noisy data, or general three-tap weights.
